units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|log|422|0
units.english: Darius was a Deep Security captain, who led an expedition sponsored by the Deep to learn more about Quarg technology. While on the return trip, he ordered his crew to investigate an anomalous extra hyperlane leading south of human space. After becoming trapped in Avgi space, the Deep crew sought refuge with the Consonance. Darius seems to blame himself for his crew's situation.
units.italian: Darius era un capitano della Sicurezza della Deep e guidava una spedizione finanziata dalla Deep per saperne di più sulla tecnologia dei Quarg. Durante il viaggio di ritorno ordinò al suo equipaggio di indagare su un'ipervia in più, anomala, che portava a sud dello spazio umano. Dopo essere rimasti intrappolati nello spazio Avgi, l'equipaggio della Deep cercò rifugio presso la Consonanza. Darius sembra incolparsi della situazione del suo equipaggio.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|From afar, the Aktina Cylinder looks like a titanic skeletal tube, with ribs of graphene and a metallic spine. Following the instructions of the station's control authority, you fly through the station's open frame to its small pressurized area, which houses the construction workers and maintenance crews.|424|0
units.english: From afar, the Aktina Cylinder looks like a titanic skeletal tube, with ribs of graphene and a metallic spine. Following the instructions of the station's control authority, you fly through the station's open frame to its small pressurized area, which houses the construction workers and maintenance crews.
units.italian: Da lontano il Cilindro Aktina sembra un tubo scheletrico titanico, con costole di grafene e una spina dorsale metallica. Seguendo le istruzioni dell'autorità di controllo della stazione, voli attraverso la struttura aperta fino alla sua piccola area pressurizzata, che ospita gli operai edili e le squadre di manutenzione.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	You've been told that word of your arrival has been sent ahead of you, so you aren't entirely surprised to see a middle-aged human waiting for you, a look of pure astonishment on his face as your ship settles into a free hangar. You disembark from the <ship> to find Darius waiting right outside the hatch.|425|0
units.english: You've been told that word of your arrival has been sent ahead of you, so you aren't entirely surprised to see a middle-aged human waiting for you, a look of pure astonishment on his face as your ship settles into a free hangar. You disembark from the <ship> to find Darius waiting right outside the hatch.
units.italian: Ti hanno detto che la notizia del tuo arrivo è stata trasmessa in anticipo, quindi non resti del tutto sorpreso nel vedere un umano di mezza età che ti aspetta, con un'espressione di puro stupore, mentre la nave si posa in un hangar libero. Scendi dalla <ship> e trovi Darius ad aspettarti proprio fuori dal portello.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"Hello there."|427|0
units.english: "Hello there."
units.italian: "Salve."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"Greetings, human. I come in peace."|428|0
units.english: "Greetings, human. I come in peace."
units.italian: "Salute, umano. Vengo in pace."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	The man blinks in surprise, then extends a hand, which you shake. "So, another one of us here in Fairyland. I don't know if I should be glad to see another friendly face, or feel bad that another soul is stranded here along with us." He shakes his head. "Let's find somewhere to talk. If you don't mind telling me, how'd you end up here anyway?"|429|0
units.english: The man blinks in surprise, then extends a hand, which you shake. "So, another one of us here in Fairyland. I don't know if I should be glad to see another friendly face, or feel bad that another soul is stranded here along with us." He shakes his head. "Let's find somewhere to talk. If you don't mind telling me, how'd you end up here anyway?"
units.italian: L'uomo sbatte le palpebre sorpreso, poi tende una mano che tu stringi. "Quindi un altro di noi qui nel Paese delle Fate. Non so se essere contento di vedere un'altra faccia amica o dispiaciuto che un'altra anima sia bloccata qui insieme a noi." Scuote la testa. "Troviamo un posto dove parlare. Se non ti dispiace dirmelo, come ci sei finito qui?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"I have a jump drive."|431|0
units.english: "I have a jump drive."
units.italian: "Ho un motore di salto."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"I have a device that can bypass hyperlanes."|432|0
units.english: "I have a device that can bypass hyperlanes."
units.italian: "Ho un dispositivo che aggira le ipervie."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	He somehow manages to look even more astonished as you walk. "A jump drive? Where the hell did you get one of those?"|433|0
units.english: He somehow manages to look even more astonished as you walk. "A jump drive? Where the hell did you get one of those?"
units.italian: Mentre camminate riesce in qualche modo a sembrare ancora più stupefatto. "Un motore di salto? E dove diavolo te lo sei procurato?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"I took it from some hostile aliens near the Core."|435|0
units.english: "I took it from some hostile aliens near the Core."
units.italian: "L'ho preso da alcuni alieni ostili vicino al Nucleo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"I took it from some aliens in the Deneb system."|439|0
units.english: "I took it from some aliens in the Deneb system."
units.italian: "L'ho preso da alcuni alieni nel sistema Deneb."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"I got it from the Syndicate, who took it from an alien race near the Core."|443|0
units.english: "I got it from the Syndicate, who took it from an alien race near the Core."
units.italian: "L'ho avuto dal Sindacato, che l'aveva preso da una specie aliena vicino al Nucleo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"I took it from some angry space squirrels."|448|0
units.english: "I took it from some angry space squirrels."
units.italian: "L'ho preso da degli scoiattoli spaziali arrabbiati."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"I took it from the Quarg."|452|0
units.english: "I took it from the Quarg."
units.italian: "L'ho preso dai Quarg."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"I'm afraid I can't tell you that."|456|0
units.english: "I'm afraid I can't tell you that."
units.italian: "Temo di non potertelo dire."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	He looks skeptical. "Alright then, keep your secrets."|457|0
units.english: He looks skeptical. "Alright then, keep your secrets."
units.italian: Sembra scettico. "Va bene, tieni pure i tuoi segreti."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"Aliens other than the Quarg?" You nod. "Huh. I've heard rumors about alien attacks in the Core before, but I always thought it was the Syndicate making excuses for the out-of-control piracy in the region."|461|0
units.english: "Aliens other than the Quarg?" You nod. "Huh. I've heard rumors about alien attacks in the Core before, but I always thought it was the Syndicate making excuses for the out-of-control piracy in the region."
units.italian: "Alieni diversi dai Quarg?" Annuisci. "Ah. Avevo già sentito voci di attacchi alieni nel Nucleo, ma ho sempre pensato che fosse il Sindacato a cercarsi scuse per la pirateria fuori controllo della regione."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"Deneb? There's no hyperlanes to that system, are there? Strange." He looks thoughtful for a moment. "I've heard stories before, of... never mind, excuse me."|465|0
units.english: "Deneb? There's no hyperlanes to that system, are there? Strange." He looks thoughtful for a moment. "I've heard stories before, of... never mind, excuse me."
units.italian: "Deneb? Non ci sono ipervie per quel sistema, vero? Strano." Resta pensieroso per un momento. "Avevo già sentito delle storie, di... lascia perdere, scusami."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"The Hai have jump drives? I didn't think their technology was that advanced." He looks thoughtful. "Unless they got them from someone else, that is."|469|0
units.english: "The Hai have jump drives? I didn't think their technology was that advanced." He looks thoughtful. "Unless they got them from someone else, that is."
units.italian: "Gli Hai hanno i motori di salto? Non pensavo che la loro tecnologia fosse così avanzata." Resta pensieroso. "A meno che non li abbiano avuti da qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"...What? You're kidding, right? How the hell did you defeat a Quarg ship?" He looks worried for a second, taking a step back. "Do I even want to be seen associating with you?" He laughs nervously.|473|0
units.english: "...What? You're kidding, right? How the hell did you defeat a Quarg ship?" He looks worried for a second, taking a step back. "Do I even want to be seen associating with you?" He laughs nervously.
units.italian: "...Cosa? Stai scherzando, vero? Come diavolo hai sconfitto una nave Quarg?" Per un istante sembra preoccupato e fa un passo indietro. "Ma voglio davvero farmi vedere in giro con te?" Ride nervosamente.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	Darius shakes his head for a moment, then looks back at you. "Well, since you're still here, I'm assuming your jump drive couldn't get you out of here?" You tell him about how you were unable to jump back to human space, and he nods along.|476|0
units.english: Darius shakes his head for a moment, then looks back at you. "Well, since you're still here, I'm assuming your jump drive couldn't get you out of here?" You tell him about how you were unable to jump back to human space, and he nods along.
units.italian: Darius scuote la testa per un momento, poi ti guarda di nuovo. "Beh, visto che sei ancora qui, immagino che il tuo motore di salto non ti abbia portato fuori?" Gli racconti che non sei riuscito a saltare indietro nello spazio umano, e lui annuisce.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"There has to be a way out, I just know it. But in six years, we've only been able to spend a few days at a time in the systems bordering human space, before those damn space shoggoths forced us back. And," he lowers his voice, looking around surreptitiously, "I don't think the Avgi are that enthusiastic about us trying to map the place either. I don't think they're exactly trying to keep us here or anything, but they've been pretty insistent on us humans not getting ourselves killed doing something stupid, like say, desperately trying to find a way back to our homes." He sounds frustrated.|477|0
units.english: "There has to be a way out, I just know it. But in six years, we've only been able to spend a few days at a time in the systems bordering human space, before those damn space shoggoths forced us back. And," he lowers his voice, looking around surreptitiously, "I don't think the Avgi are that enthusiastic about us trying to map the place either. I don't think they're exactly trying to keep us here or anything, but they've been pretty insistent on us humans not getting ourselves killed doing something stupid, like say, desperately trying to find a way back to our homes." He sounds frustrated.
units.italian: "Deve esserci una via d'uscita, lo so. Ma in sei anni siamo riusciti a passare solo pochi giorni alla volta nei sistemi che confinano con lo spazio umano, prima che quei dannati shoggoth spaziali ci respingessero. E," abbassa la voce guardandosi intorno con circospezione, "non credo che gli Avgi siano così entusiasti che proviamo a mappare il posto. Non credo che ci stiano trattenendo qui di proposito, ma insistono parecchio perché noi umani non ci facciamo ammazzare facendo qualcosa di stupido, tipo cercare disperatamente una via di casa." Sembra frustrato.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"Don't worry, I'm sure we'll find a way back home."|479|0
units.english: "Don't worry, I'm sure we'll find a way back home."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, sono sicuro che troveremo una via di casa."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"The Avgi are trying to keep you here? That's worrying."|481|0
units.english: "The Avgi are trying to keep you here? That's worrying."
units.italian: "Gli Avgi stanno cercando di trattenervi qui? È preoccupante."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"How'd you end up in Avgi space without a jump drive?"|482|0
units.english: "How'd you end up in Avgi space without a jump drive?"
units.italian: "Come siete finiti nello spazio Avgi senza un motore di salto?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"I'm probably just paranoid. After all, they're really enthusiastic about trying for an alliance with humanity to help them against these Aberrant, no matter how many times I explain humans aren't really all that technologically advanced. But they think if I can find a way home, we might be able to find a way to open up a connection between human space and Avgi space, especially given the way we got here. Not that I'd want to do that, with the chance of the Aberrant overrunning human space."|485|0
units.english: "I'm probably just paranoid. After all, they're really enthusiastic about trying for an alliance with humanity to help them against these Aberrant, no matter how many times I explain humans aren't really all that technologically advanced. But they think if I can find a way home, we might be able to find a way to open up a connection between human space and Avgi space, especially given the way we got here. Not that I'd want to do that, with the chance of the Aberrant overrunning human space."
units.italian: "Probabilmente sono solo paranoico. In fondo sono davvero entusiasti all'idea di un'alleanza con l'umanità che li aiuti contro questi Aberranti, per quante volte spieghi che gli umani non sono poi così avanzati tecnologicamente. Ma pensano che, se trovassi una via di casa, potremmo riuscire ad aprire un collegamento tra lo spazio umano e quello Avgi, soprattutto visto come siamo arrivati. Non che io voglia farlo, con il rischio che gli Aberranti travolgano lo spazio umano."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"Sometimes I find it hard to believe that we'll ever make it home, but it helps to tell myself there's hope," he says.|488|0
units.english: "Sometimes I find it hard to believe that we'll ever make it home, but it helps to tell myself there's hope," he says.
units.italian: "A volte mi riesce difficile credere che torneremo a casa, ma mi aiuta ripetermi che c'è speranza", dice.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"How'd you end up in Avgi space without a jump drive?"|490|0
units.english: "How'd you end up in Avgi space without a jump drive?"
units.italian: "Come siete finiti nello spazio Avgi senza un motore di salto?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"Funny story, that," he says. "We were part of a big convoy from Valhalla, sponsored by one of the major universities there. I was working with Deep Security, after my stint in the Navy... ended." He trails off. "Anyway, we were in a Mule carrying some scanning equipment. To research the Quarg, you see. Officially we were there for cultural outreach and exchange, you know, the usual, but really we wanted some good scans of a Wardragon. The Quarg don't really approve of it, but they don't do much to discourage it either."|493|0
units.english: "Funny story, that," he says. "We were part of a big convoy from Valhalla, sponsored by one of the major universities there. I was working with Deep Security, after my stint in the Navy... ended." He trails off. "Anyway, we were in a Mule carrying some scanning equipment. To research the Quarg, you see. Officially we were there for cultural outreach and exchange, you know, the usual, but really we wanted some good scans of a Wardragon. The Quarg don't really approve of it, but they don't do much to discourage it either."
units.italian: "Storia buffa", dice. "Facevamo parte di un grande convoglio partito da Valhalla, finanziato da una delle università più importanti di là. Lavoravo con la Sicurezza della Deep, dopo che il mio periodo in Marina... era finito." Si interrompe. "Comunque, eravamo su un Mule con a bordo apparecchiature di scansione. Per studiare i Quarg, capisci. Ufficialmente eravamo lì per scambio e divulgazione culturale, sai, il solito, ma in realtà volevamo buone scansioni di un Dragoguardia. I Quarg non approvano davvero, ma non fanno molto per impedirlo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	He continues. "So, we were on our way back, just entering Dabih. Really successful trip and everything, with a big bonus waiting for me thanks to how long the trip across the entire Republic took. But then our scanners started picking up weird readings from particular hyperlanes, and we started hearing some pirates chattering about how something weird was happening in the Sadr system. A new hyperlane, pointing south, they said. It was just a few jumps away from our current location, and we were the only Deep ship in the area that could go off alone."|494|0
units.english: He continues. "So, we were on our way back, just entering Dabih. Really successful trip and everything, with a big bonus waiting for me thanks to how long the trip across the entire Republic took. But then our scanners started picking up weird readings from particular hyperlanes, and we started hearing some pirates chattering about how something weird was happening in the Sadr system. A new hyperlane, pointing south, they said. It was just a few jumps away from our current location, and we were the only Deep ship in the area that could go off alone."
units.italian: Continua. "Dunque, stavamo tornando, appena entrati in Dabih. Viaggio davvero riuscito e tutto, con un bel bonus che mi aspettava grazie a quanto era durato il tragitto attraverso tutta la Repubblica. Ma poi i nostri scanner hanno cominciato a captare letture strane da certe ipervie, e abbiamo sentito dei pirati che chiacchieravano di qualcosa di strano nel sistema Sadr. Un'ipervia nuova, diretta a sud, dicevano. Era a pochi salti da noi, ed eravamo l'unica nave della Deep in zona che potesse andare da sola."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	He looks at his hands. "So I... I made the decision, as captain. I volunteered my crew to investigate it, to travel through that hyperlane in the name of science. For what the Deep holds highest, because I guess I wanted... I don't know. Not the prestige. But to live up to what the Deep's supposed to be, the ones at the forefront of human exploration and research. They took me in when I had nowhere else to go, and I guess I wanted to repay that somehow. And now, now a dozen good men and women are dead, and the rest are stuck here behind a hyperlane that closed the moment we went through it, living among aliens fighting a war of extinction that they probably can't win."|495|0
units.english: He looks at his hands. "So I... I made the decision, as captain. I volunteered my crew to investigate it, to travel through that hyperlane in the name of science. For what the Deep holds highest, because I guess I wanted... I don't know. Not the prestige. But to live up to what the Deep's supposed to be, the ones at the forefront of human exploration and research. They took me in when I had nowhere else to go, and I guess I wanted to repay that somehow. And now, now a dozen good men and women are dead, and the rest are stuck here behind a hyperlane that closed the moment we went through it, living among aliens fighting a war of extinction that they probably can't win."
units.italian: Guarda le sue mani. "Così io... ho preso la decisione, come capitano. Ho offerto volontario il mio equipaggio per indagare, per attraversare quell'ipervia in nome della scienza. Per ciò che la Deep tiene più in alto, perché credo di aver voluto... non lo so. Non il prestigio. Ma essere all'altezza di ciò che la Deep dovrebbe essere, quelli in prima linea nell'esplorazione e nella ricerca umana. Mi hanno preso quando non avevo altro posto dove andare, e credo di aver voluto ripagarlo in qualche modo. E ora, ora una dozzina di uomini e donne validi sono morti, e gli altri sono bloccati qui dietro un'ipervia che si è chiusa appena l'abbiamo attraversata, a vivere tra alieni che combattono una guerra di sterminio che probabilmente non possono vincere."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"The other members of your crew, where are they now?"|497|0
units.english: "The other members of your crew, where are they now?"
units.italian: "Gli altri membri del tuo equipaggio, dove sono adesso?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"There are a few of us left," he sighs, "but, well, I'm not on the best of terms with them. They blame me for bringing them here, and I can't fault them for it."|499|0
units.english: "There are a few of us left," he sighs, "but, well, I'm not on the best of terms with them. They blame me for bringing them here, and I can't fault them for it."
units.italian: "Ne restiamo pochi", sospira, "ma, beh, non ho buoni rapporti con loro. Mi incolpano di averli portati qui, e non posso dargli torto."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"That seems unfair. There's no way you could have known what would happen."|501|0
units.english: "That seems unfair. There's no way you could have known what would happen."
units.italian: "Mi sembra ingiusto. Non potevi sapere cosa sarebbe successo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"Is there a chance of reconciling with them?"|503|0
units.english: "Is there a chance of reconciling with them?"
units.italian: "C'è la possibilità di riconciliarti con loro?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"I've made... a lot of mistakes. Ones with a price paid in lives. But," he looks down, "...maybe. They don't hate me or anything like that, we just... keep our distance. Sora's off doing who knows what with the Twilight Guard on Weledos, and Leon is on and off with those mining guilds to the East. There are a few others left too, but like I said. A price paid in lives."|504|0
units.english: "I've made... a lot of mistakes. Ones with a price paid in lives. But," he looks down, "...maybe. They don't hate me or anything like that, we just... keep our distance. Sora's off doing who knows what with the Twilight Guard on Weledos, and Leon is on and off with those mining guilds to the East. There are a few others left too, but like I said. A price paid in lives."
units.italian: "Ho fatto... molti errori. Con un prezzo pagato in vite. Ma", abbassa lo sguardo, "...forse. Non mi odiano né niente del genere, semplicemente... manteniamo le distanze. Sora è in giro a fare chissà cosa con la Twilight Guard su Weledos, e Leon va e viene dalle gilde minerarie a est. Ne restano anche altri, ma come dicevo. Un prezzo pagato in vite."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	"I wish it was that simple. I made more mistakes after that, ones with a price measured in lives. Eleven dead after our ship was disabled, all because I ordered us to get too close to the scary-looking alien ships in the hope we could communicate with them. Sure, you could say I couldn't have known the Aberrant would try to kill us, but I ignored the advice of my crew, just because I was desperate to get home. Sora, Leon, they both told me we should run, but I didn't listen to them."|508|0
units.english: "I wish it was that simple. I made more mistakes after that, ones with a price measured in lives. Eleven dead after our ship was disabled, all because I ordered us to get too close to the scary-looking alien ships in the hope we could communicate with them. Sure, you could say I couldn't have known the Aberrant would try to kill us, but I ignored the advice of my crew, just because I was desperate to get home. Sora, Leon, they both told me we should run, but I didn't listen to them."
units.italian: "Vorrei che fosse così semplice. Dopo ho fatto altri errori, con un prezzo misurato in vite. Undici morti dopo che la nostra nave è stata immobilizzata, tutto perché ho ordinato di avvicinarci troppo a quelle navi aliene dall'aria spaventosa nella speranza di comunicare con loro. Certo, si può dire che non potevo sapere che gli Aberranti avrebbero cercato di ucciderci, ma ho ignorato il consiglio del mio equipaggio, solo perché ero disperato di tornare a casa. Sora e Leon mi hanno detto entrambi che dovevamo fuggire, e non li ho ascoltati."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	You sit together in silence for a few more minutes, when Darius seems to receive a message on his communicator. "I get patched in to the emergency alert system," he explains as he reads it. Suddenly, he pales. "A scout is reporting a massive invasion headed towards the Ensemble system. Dozens of Aberrations, flying straight through the Shroud." He looks up at you. "They don't normally try to go too deep in the Shroud. Something about it spooks them, I think, but Ensemble is shallow enough that they've attacked it before. Nothing of this scale though, and... damn, Sora's on Weledos, the moon in the Ensemble system."|511|0

"I get patched in to the emergency alert system," he explains as he reads it. Suddenly, he pales. "A scout is reporting a massive invasion headed towards the Ensemble system. Dozens of Aberrations, flying straight through the Shroud." He looks up at you. "They don't normally try to go too deep in the Shroud. Something about it spooks them, I think, but Ensemble is shallow enough that they've attacked it before. Nothing of this scale though, and... damn, Sora's on Weledos, the moon in the Ensemble system."
units.italian: Restate insieme in silenzio per qualche altro minuto, quando Darius sembra ricevere un messaggio sul comunicatore. "Sono collegato al sistema di allerta d'emergenza", spiega mentre lo legge. All'improvviso sbianca. "Un'esploratrice segnala un'invasione enorme diretta verso il sistema Ensemble. Dozzine di Aberrazioni, che volano dritte attraverso lo Shroud." Alza lo sguardo su di te. "Di solito non cercano di addentrarsi troppo nello Shroud. Qualcosa li spaventa, credo, ma Ensemble è abbastanza in superficie perché l'abbiano già attaccato. Però niente di questa portata, e... accidenti, Sora è su Weledos, la luna del sistema Ensemble."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|	He looks at you, hopeful. "We've got to do something. The Avgi are assembling a relief force around the Navigeo Yards, their big shipyard not too far from here. Come on, let's join it."|512|0
units.english: He looks at you, hopeful. "We've got to do something. The Avgi are assembling a relief force around the Navigeo Yards, their big shipyard not too far from here. Come on, let's join it."
units.italian: Ti guarda, speranzoso. "Dobbiamo fare qualcosa. Gli Avgi stanno radunando una forza di soccorso intorno ai Navigeo Yards, il loro grande cantiere qui vicino. Dai, uniamoci."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 1|dialog|515|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Darius hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la scorta che porta Darius non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|name|521|0
units.english: Ensemble Defense
units.italian: Difesa di Ensemble

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|description|522|0
units.english: Help the Avgi in the Ensemble system hold off an Aberrant raid until help arrives.
units.italian: Aiuta gli Avgi nel sistema Ensemble a respingere un'incursione degli Aberranti finché non arrivano i rinforzi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|blocked|526|0
units.english: You'll need a free bunk on the <ship> to take Darius to <planet>.
units.italian: Ti serve una cuccetta libera sulla <ship> per portare Darius su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|log|530|0
units.english: Agreed to help the Twilight Guard defend the Ensemble system from an Aberrant raid inside the Tangled Shroud. The Avgi appear to enthusiastically use nuclear weapons, contrary to the taboo most humans place on them.
units.italian: Ho accettato di aiutare la Twilight Guard a difendere il sistema Ensemble da un'incursione degli Aberranti dentro il Tangled Shroud. Gli Avgi sembrano usare con entusiasmo le armi nucleari, contrariamente al tabù che la maggior parte degli umani vi associa.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|log|531|0
units.english: The Twilight Guard is the military arm of the Avgi Consonance, a unified command created in response to the Aberrant incursion.
units.italian: La Twilight Guard è il braccio militare della Consonanza Avgi, un comando unificato creato in risposta all'incursione degli Aberranti.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|log|532|0
units.english: Notably, the Avgi appear to have no taboo around nuclear weapons, and use them freely against the Aberrant.
units.italian: È notevole che gli Avgi non abbiano alcun tabù sulle armi nucleari e le usino liberamente contro gli Aberranti.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|Navigeo is buzzing with activity as you pull into one of the few open berths available. Avgi ships of all sizes, painted in the deep blue of the Twilight Guard, launch every few minutes, replaced moments later by battle-scarred warships that slip into dry dock for repair.|534|0
units.english: Navigeo is buzzing with activity as you pull into one of the few open berths available. Avgi ships of all sizes, painted in the deep blue of the Twilight Guard, launch every few minutes, replaced moments later by battle-scarred warships that slip into dry dock for repair.
units.italian: Navigeo brulica di attività mentre ti infili in uno dei pochi ormeggi liberi. Navi Avgi di ogni dimensione, dipinte del blu profondo della Twilight Guard, decollano ogni pochi minuti e vengono sostituite poco dopo da navi da guerra segnate dalla battaglia, che scivolano in bacino per le riparazioni.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	Parked a few kilometers from the station, a fleetgroup is assembling in a wide formation. You see a handful of cruiser-sized ships, along with a dozen smaller ships congregated around them. You hail them, asking to join the formation, and a surprised Avgi admiral directs you to fly towards the Ensemble system.|535|0
units.english: Parked a few kilometers from the station, a fleetgroup is assembling in a wide formation. You see a handful of cruiser-sized ships, along with a dozen smaller ships congregated around them. You hail them, asking to join the formation, and a surprised Avgi admiral directs you to fly towards the Ensemble system.
units.italian: Ormeggiata a qualche chilometro dalla stazione, una formazione si sta radunando in schieramento ampio. Vedi una manciata di navi delle dimensioni di un incrociatore, con una dozzina di navi più piccole raccolte intorno. Le chiami, chiedendo di unirti alla formazione, e un ammiraglio Avgi sorpreso ti indica di volare verso il sistema Ensemble.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Warning. Atomics will be used in the upcoming battle, so keep your distance from our warheads," she says. "It would be appreciated if you flew ahead of our fleet and cleared out any straggler Aberrant in the way, so that we can save as many atomics as possible for the battle in Ensemble."|536|0
units.english: "Warning. Atomics will be used in the upcoming battle, so keep your distance from our warheads," she says. "It would be appreciated if you flew ahead of our fleet and cleared out any straggler Aberrant in the way, so that we can save as many atomics as possible for the battle in Ensemble."
units.italian: "Avviso. Nel combattimento che sta per iniziare si useranno atomiche, quindi tieni le distanze dalle nostre testate", dice. "Apprezzeremmo se volassi davanti alla flotta e liberassi la strada dagli Aberranti rimasti indietro, così possiamo risparmiare quante più atomiche possibile per la battaglia di Ensemble."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Acknowledged."|538|0
units.english: "Acknowledged."
units.italian: "Ricevuto."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Wait, nuclear weapons? You people use those?"|540|0
units.english: "Wait, nuclear weapons? You people use those?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, armi nucleari? Voi le usate?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Confusion. Yes, of course. What else would we use, beam weapons?" She flicks her wings. "Don't tell me you're a beam fan, I'll have you know guided weapons win every time."|542|0
units.english: "Confusion. Yes, of course. What else would we use, beam weapons?" She flicks her wings. "Don't tell me you're a beam fan, I'll have you know guided weapons win every time."
units.italian: "Confusione. Sì, certo. Che altro dovremmo usare, armi a fasci?" Agita le ali. "Non dirmi che sei un fan dei fasci, sappi che le armi guidate vincono sempre."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"It's nothing, I was just surprised."|544|0
units.english: "It's nothing, I was just surprised."
units.italian: "Niente, ero solo sorpreso."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"I'm not sure I'm comfortable with weapons of genocide."|546|0
units.english: "I'm not sure I'm comfortable with weapons of genocide."
units.italian: "Non sono sicuro che le armi di genocidio mi mettano a mio agio."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Annoyance. It's not like we're using them against civilian targets, or even a planetary target to begin with. Honestly, you humans have some strange sensibilities."|548|0
units.english: "Annoyance. It's not like we're using them against civilian targets, or even a planetary target to begin with. Honestly, you humans have some strange sensibilities."
units.italian: "Fastidio. Non è che le usiamo contro obiettivi civili, né tantomeno planetari. Davvero, voi umani avete una sensibilità strana."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	She turns away from the viewscreen as another Avgi starts speaking to her, dismissing you with a flick of her fingers.|551|0
units.english: She turns away from the viewscreen as another Avgi starts speaking to her, dismissing you with a flick of her fingers.
units.italian: Si volta dallo schermo mentre un altro Avgi comincia a parlarle, congedandoti con un movimento delle dita.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|dialog|635|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Aberrant attacking the system. You should take off and help the Avgi defeat them.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora Aberranti che attaccano il sistema. Dovresti decollare e aiutare gli Avgi a sconfiggerli.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|log|638|0
units.english: Defended Ensemble from the Aberrant raid with the help of a fleet of Twilight Guard ships armed with nuclear weapons. The Aberrant apparently do not usually raid this deep into the Tangled Shroud, which makes the size of this battle worrying.
units.italian: Ho difeso Ensemble dall'incursione degli Aberranti con l'aiuto di una flotta di navi della Twilight Guard armate di testate nucleari. A quanto pare gli Aberranti non si spingono di solito così in profondità nel Tangled Shroud, il che rende preoccupanti le dimensioni di questa battaglia.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|log|639|0
units.english: Sora was part of the Deep expedition that became trapped in Avgi space, serving as an engineer. She has been assisting the Twilight Guard with reinforcing their defenses in the Tangled Shroud. Despite Darius' fears, she does not appear to blame him for their predicament.
units.italian: Sora faceva parte della spedizione della Deep rimasta intrappolata nello spazio Avgi, dove prestava servizio come ingegnera. Ha aiutato la Twilight Guard a rinforzare le difese nel Tangled Shroud. Nonostante i timori di Darius, non sembra incolparlo della loro situazione.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|log|640|0
units.english: Despite Darius' pessimism, at least some of his crew do not blame him for their situation.
units.italian: Nonostante il pessimismo di Darius, almeno alcuni del suo equipaggio non lo incolpano della loro situazione.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|log|641|0
units.english: Kokkino is a Captain in the Twilight Guard, who seems interested in the possible help you can provide the Avgi.
units.italian: Kokkino è un capitano della Twilight Guard e sembra interessato all'aiuto che puoi dare agli Avgi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|You land on Weledos after the battle, while most of the surviving Avgi ships begin temporary repairs in orbit before they travel back to the Navigeo Yards. While you and Darius are checking the <ship> for damage, you hear someone walk up with distinctly human footsteps.|643|0
units.english: You land on Weledos after the battle, while most of the surviving Avgi ships begin temporary repairs in orbit before they travel back to the Navigeo Yards. While you and Darius are checking the <ship> for damage, you hear someone walk up with distinctly human footsteps.
units.italian: Atterri su Weledos dopo la battaglia, mentre la maggior parte delle navi Avgi sopravvissute comincia in orbita le riparazioni temporanee prima di tornare ai Navigeo Yards. Mentre tu e Darius controllate la <ship> in cerca di danni, senti qualcuno avvicinarsi con passi chiaramente umani.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"So, those rumors weren't all talk. There really is another one of us here." You look up to see a woman in combat fatigues standing in front of you, hand extended.|644|0
units.english: "So, those rumors weren't all talk. There really is another one of us here." You look up to see a woman in combat fatigues standing in front of you, hand extended.
units.italian: "Quindi non erano solo chiacchiere. C'è davvero un altro di noi qui." Alzi lo sguardo e vedi una donna in divisa da combattimento davanti a te, con la mano tesa.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	(Shake her hand.)|646|0
units.english: (Shake her hand.)
units.italian: (Le stringi la mano.)

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Who are you?"|648|0
units.english: "Who are you?"
units.italian: "Chi sei?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	She drops her hand after a moment. "Name's Sora. And you?"|649|0
units.english: She drops her hand after a moment. "Name's Sora. And you?"
units.italian: Dopo un momento abbassa la mano. "Mi chiamo Sora. E tu?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Name's Sora. And you?"|652|0
units.english: "Name's Sora. And you?"
units.italian: "Mi chiamo Sora. E tu?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Captain <first> <last>," you say.|654|0
units.english: "Captain <first> <last>," you say.
units.italian: "Il capitano <first> <last>", dici.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"And I see you've got a tagalong, too. Finally got ol' Darius to come out of his shell, did you?" You look over at Darius, a look of deep shame on his face as he stares at the ground.|655|0
units.english: "And I see you've got a tagalong, too. Finally got ol' Darius to come out of his shell, did you?" You look over at Darius, a look of deep shame on his face as he stares at the ground.
units.italian: "E vedo che hai anche un accompagnatore. Sei riuscito a far uscire il vecchio Darius dal suo guscio?" Guardi Darius, che fissa il suolo con un'espressione di profonda vergogna.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Now, I'm very interested in how exactly you managed to find your way here. Care to explain?" she asks.|656|0
units.english: "Now, I'm very interested in how exactly you managed to find your way here. Care to explain?" she asks.
units.italian: "Ora, mi interessa molto come esattamente sei riuscito a trovarti qui. Vuoi spiegare?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	You fill Sora in on how your travels brought you here, and how you were able to acquire a jump drive. Darius says nothing throughout, standing by silently.|657|0
units.english: You fill Sora in on how your travels brought you here, and how you were able to acquire a jump drive. Darius says nothing throughout, standing by silently.
units.italian: Metti Sora al corrente di come i tuoi viaggi ti hanno portato qui e di come sei riuscito a procurarti un motore di salto. Darius non dice nulla per tutto il tempo, restando in silenzio accanto a voi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Amazing. So, your jump drive can get us out of here then?"|658|0
units.english: "Amazing. So, your jump drive can get us out of here then?"
units.italian: "Incredibile. Quindi il tuo motore di salto può portarci fuori di qui?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"I'm afraid not. It can't return to human space for some reason."|660|0
units.english: "I'm afraid not. It can't return to human space for some reason."
units.italian: "Temo di no. Per qualche ragione non può tornare nello spazio umano."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"No, but I'm not giving up on finding a different way out."|661|0
units.english: "No, but I'm not giving up on finding a different way out."
units.italian: "No, ma non rinuncio a trovare un'altra via d'uscita."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Nope!"|662|0
units.english: "Nope!"
units.italian: "Macché!"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Damn. That would be too easy, I guess. But it's been too long since I've seen a fresh human face. I've been working for the Twilight Guard here for months, trying to build up a second line of defenses in case that station in Arche falls. At least today's battle shows those defenses, together with a supporting fleet, can hold. You mind if I tag along with you, in case you do manage to find a way out?"|663|0
units.english: "Damn. That would be too easy, I guess. But it's been too long since I've seen a fresh human face. I've been working for the Twilight Guard here for months, trying to build up a second line of defenses in case that station in Arche falls. At least today's battle shows those defenses, together with a supporting fleet, can hold. You mind if I tag along with you, in case you do manage to find a way out?"
units.italian: "Accidenti. Sarebbe stato troppo facile, immagino. Ma è troppo tempo che non vedo una faccia umana nuova. Lavoro per la Twilight Guard qui da mesi, cercando di costruire una seconda linea di difesa nel caso cada quella stazione ad Arche. Almeno la battaglia di oggi dimostra che quelle difese, insieme a una flotta di supporto, possono reggere. Ti dispiace se mi unisco a te, nel caso riuscissi davvero a trovare una via d'uscita?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Of course."|665|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certo che no."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Sure, as long as Darius doesn't mind."|667|0
units.english: "Sure, as long as Darius doesn't mind."
units.italian: "Certo, purché Darius non abbia niente in contrario."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	You look over at Darius, who responds after a few seconds of silence. "Of course you can come along, Sora."|668|0
units.english: You look over at Darius, who responds after a few seconds of silence. "Of course you can come along, Sora."
units.italian: Guardi Darius, che risponde dopo qualche secondo di silenzio. "Certo che puoi venire, Sora."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Sounds good to me, then. I'll see you around when you're ready to leave." She walks off to collect her belongings.|670|0
units.english: "Sounds good to me, then. I'll see you around when you're ready to leave." She walks off to collect her belongings.
units.italian: "Allora per me va bene. Ci vediamo quando sei pronto a partire." Si allontana per raccogliere le sue cose.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	A few hours later, an Avgi cruiser, a Refraktos-class Laserstar, settles down on the pad next to yours, and an Avgi officer disembarks.|671|0
units.english: A few hours later, an Avgi cruiser, a Refraktos-class Laserstar, settles down on the pad next to yours, and an Avgi officer disembarks.
units.italian: Qualche ora dopo, un incrociatore Avgi, una Laserstar classe Refraktos, si posa sulla piazzola accanto alla tua e ne scende un ufficiale Avgi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Salutations. Hello, Captain <first> <last>. My name is Kokkino, Captain of the Spectral Collision. Tell me, is the <ship> a warship, question?"|672|0
units.english: "Salutations. Hello, Captain <first> <last>. My name is Kokkino, Captain of the Spectral Collision. Tell me, is the <ship> a warship, question?"
units.italian: "Saluti. Ciao, capitano <first> <last>. Mi chiamo Kokkino, capitano della Spectral Collision. Dimmi, la <ship> è una nave da guerra, domanda?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Yes, the <ship> is as powerful as they come."|674|0
units.english: "Yes, the <ship> is as powerful as they come."
units.italian: "Sì, la <ship> è potente come poche."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"No, the <ship> isn't made for combat."|676|0
units.english: "No, the <ship> isn't made for combat."
units.italian: "No, la <ship> non è fatta per il combattimento."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Consideration. But, are you still willing to help us in a way that takes advantage of your ship's ability to bypass the starways, question?"|679|0
units.english: "Consideration. But, are you still willing to help us in a way that takes advantage of your ship's ability to bypass the starways, question?"
units.italian: "Considerazione. Ma sei comunque disposto ad aiutarci sfruttando la capacità della tua nave di aggirare le vie stellari, domanda?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Yes, of course."|681|0
units.english: "Yes, of course."
units.italian: "Sì, certo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"I'll hear you out."|682|0
units.english: "I'll hear you out."
units.italian: "Ti ascolto."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Approval. That is very good, for your unique capabilities may help us save the lives of some very brave people. Come, meet me in the spaceport in an hour." He gives you a set of directions to a small building in Ensemble's main spaceport before leaving. "We will have much to discuss."|683|0
units.english: "Approval. That is very good, for your unique capabilities may help us save the lives of some very brave people. Come, meet me in the spaceport in an hour." He gives you a set of directions to a small building in Ensemble's main spaceport before leaving. "We will have much to discuss."
units.italian: "Approvazione. Ottimo, perché le tue capacità uniche possono aiutarci a salvare la vita di persone molto coraggiose. Vieni, incontrami allo spazioporto tra un'ora." Ti dà le indicazioni per raggiungere un piccolo edificio nello spazioporto principale di Ensemble, poi se ne va. "Avremo molto di cui parlare."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Excellent. I am unsurprised, given its performance in the battle, but for all we know your alien vessel could be a simple freighter and yet still be formidable in our eyes. Are you willing to assist us with your warship's strength, question?"|689|0
units.english: "Excellent. I am unsurprised, given its performance in the battle, but for all we know your alien vessel could be a simple freighter and yet still be formidable in our eyes. Are you willing to assist us with your warship's strength, question?"
units.italian: "Eccellente. Non ne sono sorpreso, vista la sua condotta in battaglia, ma per quanto ne sappiamo la tua nave aliena potrebbe essere un semplice mercantile e sembrarci comunque formidabile. Sei disposto ad aiutarci con la forza della tua nave da guerra, domanda?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Yes, of course."|691|0
units.english: "Yes, of course."
units.italian: "Sì, certo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"I'll hear you out."|692|0
units.english: "I'll hear you out."
units.italian: "Ti ascolto."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"Enthusiasm. Your help will save many lives. Then, if you would, meet me in the spaceport in an hour." He gives you a set of directions to a small building in Ensemble's main spaceport before leaving. "We will have much to discuss."|693|0
units.english: "Enthusiasm. Your help will save many lives. Then, if you would, meet me in the spaceport in an hour." He gives you a set of directions to a small building in Ensemble's main spaceport before leaving. "We will have much to discuss."
units.italian: "Entusiasmo. Il tuo aiuto salverà molte vite. Allora, se vuoi, incontrami allo spazioporto tra un'ora." Ti dà le indicazioni per raggiungere un piccolo edificio nello spazioporto principale di Ensemble, poi se ne va. "Avremo molto di cui parlare."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	Darius exits the <ship> behind you. "What was that about?" he asks.|696|0
units.english: Darius exits the <ship> behind you. "What was that about?" he asks.
units.italian: Darius esce dalla <ship> dietro di te. "Di cosa si trattava?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"It sounds like they'd like my help with something."|698|0
units.english: "It sounds like they'd like my help with something."
units.italian: "Sembra che vogliano il mio aiuto per qualcosa."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"I'm going to help them with the war effort."|699|0
units.english: "I'm going to help them with the war effort."
units.italian: "Ho intenzione di aiutarli nello sforzo bellico."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	He frowns. "I see. When do you think we'll be able to head up north to look for a way out?"|700|0
units.english: He frowns. "I see. When do you think we'll be able to head up north to look for a way out?"
units.italian: Aggrotta la fronte. "Capisco. E quando pensi che potremo andare a nord a cercare una via d'uscita?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"We'll do it soon, I promise."|702|0
units.english: "We'll do it soon, I promise."
units.italian: "Lo faremo presto, te lo prometto."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"I'm not sure."|703|0
units.english: "I'm not sure."
units.italian: "Non ne sono sicuro."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	He looks a little disappointed, then collects himself. "Well, I suppose there's no real urgency to it. Though, I've been thinking. If your jump drive wasn't able to let you escape from the north, there might not be a point in looking in that direction."|704|0
units.english: He looks a little disappointed, then collects himself. "Well, I suppose there's no real urgency to it. Though, I've been thinking. If your jump drive wasn't able to let you escape from the north, there might not be a point in looking in that direction."
units.italian: Sembra un po' deluso, poi si riprende. "Beh, suppongo che non ci sia poi tutta questa fretta. Però stavo pensando. Se il tuo motore di salto non ti ha permesso di fuggire da nord, forse non ha senso cercare in quella direzione."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"What do you suggest?" you ask.|705|0
units.english: "What do you suggest?" you ask.
units.italian: "Cosa suggerisci?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Defend Ensemble 2|	"I have a friend among the Avgi, one who doesn't frequent the official circles in the Consonance as much. There's a number of hideaways and side branches in the Tangled Shroud, with outposts mostly ran by miners and small-time shipbuilders. Just the kind of people who talk a lot among themselves about rumors and tall tales. The official story of the Incursion, the invasion of the Aberrant, is that they came from a chain of systems in the East, but no one ever talks about where exactly that chain leads. I think we should pay my friend a visit after you wrap up this next mission."|706|0
units.english: "I have a friend among the Avgi, one who doesn't frequent the official circles in the Consonance as much. There's a number of hideaways and side branches in the Tangled Shroud, with outposts mostly ran by miners and small-time shipbuilders. Just the kind of people who talk a lot among themselves about rumors and tall tales. The official story of the Incursion, the invasion of the Aberrant, is that they came from a chain of systems in the East, but no one ever talks about where exactly that chain leads. I think we should pay my friend a visit after you wrap up this next mission."
units.italian: "Ho un amico tra gli Avgi, uno che non frequenta molto i circoli ufficiali della Consonanza. Nel Tangled Shroud ci sono diversi rifugi e rami secondari, con avamposti gestiti per lo più da minatori e piccoli cantieri navali. Proprio il tipo di gente che chiacchiera molto tra sé di voci e storie esagerate. La versione ufficiale dell'Incursione, dell'invasione degli Aberranti, è che siano arrivati da una catena di sistemi a est, ma nessuno parla mai di dove porti esattamente quella catena. Penso che dovremmo fare visita al mio amico dopo che avrai concluso la prossima missione."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|name|710|0
units.english: Search and Rescue
units.italian: Ricerca e soccorso

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|description|711|0
units.english: Find and evacuate the crew of the <npc>, which was last seen in the Twirl system, but could be anywhere in the local star cluster.
units.italian: Trova ed evacua l'equipaggio della <npc>, vista l'ultima volta nel sistema Twirl ma forse in qualunque punto dell'ammasso stellare locale.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|blocked|716|0
units.english: You'll need <capacity> to complete this mission.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per completare questa missione.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|You follow Kokkino's instructions to a prefab building in the spaceport, which looks to be some kind of command center. Kokkino is waiting for you by a table in the middle, which lights up, displaying a map of Avgi space with some colored markings you can't read.|723|0
units.english: You follow Kokkino's instructions to a prefab building in the spaceport, which looks to be some kind of command center. Kokkino is waiting for you by a table in the middle, which lights up, displaying a map of Avgi space with some colored markings you can't read.
units.italian: Segui le indicazioni di Kokkino fino a un edificio prefabbricato nello spazioporto, che sembra una specie di centro di comando. Kokkino ti aspetta accanto a un tavolo al centro, che si illumina mostrando una mappa dello spazio Avgi con segni colorati che non sai leggere.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"Explanation. We send scouting teams and patrols into the space controlled by the Aberrant regularly. Every expedition beyond Evanescence is essentially behind enemy lines, cut off from resupply and in many cases communication. As you might imagine, such adventures are fraught with danger, and it is unfortunately not unheard of for a scout ship to be lost."|724|0
units.english: "Explanation. We send scouting teams and patrols into the space controlled by the Aberrant regularly. Every expedition beyond Evanescence is essentially behind enemy lines, cut off from resupply and in many cases communication. As you might imagine, such adventures are fraught with danger, and it is unfortunately not unheard of for a scout ship to be lost."
units.italian: "Spiegazione. Mandiamo regolarmente squadre di ricognizione e pattuglie nello spazio controllato dagli Aberranti. Ogni spedizione oltre Evanescence è sostanzialmente dietro le linee nemiche, tagliata fuori dai rifornimenti e in molti casi dalle comunicazioni. Come puoi immaginare, simili avventure sono piene di pericoli, e purtroppo non è raro che una nave esploratrice vada perduta."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"Yes, I've found that exploration is often dangerous."|726|0
units.english: "Yes, I've found that exploration is often dangerous."
units.italian: "Sì, ho scoperto che l'esplorazione è spesso pericolosa."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"Sounds like you should build stronger scout ships."|728|0
units.english: "Sounds like you should build stronger scout ships."
units.italian: "Direi che dovreste costruire esploratrici più robuste."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"Agreement. The Polari are a fine line of vessels, but not one made for the environment of war. We have experimented with using the Prismaios as an intelligence platform in more contested environments, but it lacks the versatility and drone bays that have made the Polari so venerable in the first place."|729|0
units.english: "Agreement. The Polari are a fine line of vessels, but not one made for the environment of war. We have experimented with using the Prismaios as an intelligence platform in more contested environments, but it lacks the versatility and drone bays that have made the Polari so venerable in the first place."
units.italian: "Accordo. Le Polari sono una bella linea di vascelli, ma non sono fatte per l'ambiente della guerra. Abbiamo sperimentato l'uso della Prismaios come piattaforma di intelligence in ambienti più contesi, ma le mancano la versatilità e le baie per droni che hanno reso le Polari così rispettabili fin dall'inizio."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	He flicks his wings. "Regret. It is a sad truth, but those on the forefront of expanding our knowledge are often those who face the most danger from the unknown."|732|0
units.english: He flicks his wings. "Regret. It is a sad truth, but those on the forefront of expanding our knowledge are often those who face the most danger from the unknown."
units.italian: Agita le ali. "Rincrescimento. È una verità triste, ma chi sta in prima linea nell'ampliare la nostra conoscenza è spesso chi affronta il pericolo maggiore, quello dell'ignoto."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"But, to the point. A scout team, aboard the Polari-class scout 'Silver Albedo,' was sent to survey the Twirl system two weeks ago, but has missed its check-in by multiple days. To reach that star cluster and return would normally require a trip of weeks, all through perilous territory, and I am ashamed to say that we could be forced to consider writing off the scouts as lost. But I have heard that the visiting human, Captain <last>, is in possession of a new kind of faster-than-light drive, one that can travel without the need for starways. Tell me, is this true, question?"|734|0
units.english: "But, to the point. A scout team, aboard the Polari-class scout 'Silver Albedo,' was sent to survey the Twirl system two weeks ago, but has missed its check-in by multiple days. To reach that star cluster and return would normally require a trip of weeks, all through perilous territory, and I am ashamed to say that we could be forced to consider writing off the scouts as lost. But I have heard that the visiting human, Captain <last>, is in possession of a new kind of faster-than-light drive, one that can travel without the need for starways. Tell me, is this true, question?"
units.italian: "Ma veniamo al punto. Una squadra di ricognizione, a bordo dell'esploratrice classe Polari 'Silver Albedo', è stata inviata due settimane fa a sorvegliare il sistema Twirl, ma ha mancato il rapporto da diversi giorni. Raggiungere quell'ammasso stellare e tornare richiederebbe normalmente un viaggio di settimane, tutto attraverso territorio pericoloso, e mi vergogno a dire che potremmo essere costretti a considerare gli esploratori perduti. Ma ho sentito che l'umano in visita, il capitano <last>, possiede un nuovo tipo di motore più veloce della luce, capace di viaggiare senza bisogno delle vie stellari. Dimmi, è vero, domanda?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"Yes."|736|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"Yes, it's called a jump drive."|737|0
units.english: "Yes, it's called a jump drive."
units.italian: "Sì, si chiama motore di salto."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"Excitement. Then, the trip could be shortened to mere days, giving us the possibility of mounting a rescue. I will mark the location of the Twirl system on your map, though it is probable that the Silver Albedo is elsewhere in the star cluster. The highest priority is of course the safe recovery of its crew, though if you could recover any data or samples they have managed to gather, that would also be much appreciated."|738|0
units.english: "Excitement. Then, the trip could be shortened to mere days, giving us the possibility of mounting a rescue. I will mark the location of the Twirl system on your map, though it is probable that the Silver Albedo is elsewhere in the star cluster. The highest priority is of course the safe recovery of its crew, though if you could recover any data or samples they have managed to gather, that would also be much appreciated."
units.italian: "Entusiasmo. Allora il viaggio potrebbe ridursi a pochi giorni, dandoci la possibilità di organizzare un salvataggio. Segnerò la posizione del sistema Twirl sulla tua mappa, anche se è probabile che la Silver Albedo sia altrove nell'ammasso stellare. La priorità assoluta è naturalmente recuperare l'equipaggio incolume, ma se riuscissi a recuperare anche dati o campioni che sono riusciti a raccogliere, sarebbe molto apprezzato."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|log|741|0
units.english: Agreed to help Kokkino by trying to rescue the crew of an Avgi scout ship that failed to report in from a mission in the Twilight.
units.italian: Ho accettato di aiutare Kokkino provando a salvare l'equipaggio di una nave esploratrice Avgi che non ha più dato notizie dopo una missione nel Twilight.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|dialog|745|0
units.english: You've reached the Twirl system, but there is no sign of the Silver Albedo. Perhaps you should check the rest of this star cluster.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto il sistema Twirl, ma non c'è traccia della Silver Albedo. Forse dovresti controllare il resto di questo ammasso stellare.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|You maneuver alongside the Silver Albedo, which is covered in scorch marks and other signs of damage. After transmitting a code given to you by Captain Kokkino, you wait for any signs of life. After a few minutes you receive a response, which you pass through your translator.|753|0
units.english: You maneuver alongside the Silver Albedo, which is covered in scorch marks and other signs of damage. After transmitting a code given to you by Captain Kokkino, you wait for any signs of life. After a few minutes you receive a response, which you pass through your translator.
units.italian: Ti affianchi alla Silver Albedo, coperta di bruciature e di altri segni di danni. Dopo aver trasmesso un codice datoti dal capitano Kokkino, aspetti un qualsiasi segno di vita. Dopo qualche minuto ricevi una risposta, che fai passare dal traduttore.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"Caution. Unfamiliar vessel, how did you obtain Consonance identification codes?"|754|0
units.english: "Caution. Unfamiliar vessel, how did you obtain Consonance identification codes?"
units.italian: "Cautela. Vascello sconosciuto, come hai ottenuto i codici di identificazione della Consonanza?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"There's no time for that. I'm here to rescue you."|756|0
units.english: "There's no time for that. I'm here to rescue you."
units.italian: "Non c'è tempo per questo. Sono qui per salvarvi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"I'm a space alien here in my alien spaceship here to rescue you aliens."|758|0
units.english: "I'm a space alien here in my alien spaceship here to rescue you aliens."
units.italian: "Sono un alieno spaziale, qui nella mia nave spaziale aliena, per salvare voi alieni."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"Amusement. Very well, I suppose we have little choice but to accept your help, opportune jester. As you can see, the Albedo is in something of a predicament."|759|0
units.english: "Amusement. Very well, I suppose we have little choice but to accept your help, opportune jester. As you can see, the Albedo is in something of a predicament."
units.italian: "Divertimento. Molto bene, suppongo che non ci resti altra scelta che accettare il tuo aiuto, buffone capitato a proposito. Come vedi, l'Albedo si trova in una sorta di brutto guaio."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"Consideration. I suppose we have little choice but to accept your help, stranger. As you can see, the Albedo is in something of a predicament."|762|0
units.english: "Consideration. I suppose we have little choice but to accept your help, stranger. As you can see, the Albedo is in something of a predicament."
units.italian: "Considerazione. Suppongo che non ci resti altra scelta che accettare il tuo aiuto, straniero. Come vedi, l'Albedo si trova in una sorta di brutto guaio."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	You speak with the Avgi commander about treating the wounded as you dock your ship with the Silver Albedo. Any Avgi that are able to are clutching armfuls of recordings and logs as they come aboard. After everyone is safely transferred to the <ship>, you decouple from the derelict ship.|764|0
units.english: You speak with the Avgi commander about treating the wounded as you dock your ship with the Silver Albedo. Any Avgi that are able to are clutching armfuls of recordings and logs as they come aboard. After everyone is safely transferred to the <ship>, you decouple from the derelict ship.
units.italian: Parli con il comandante Avgi di come curare i feriti mentre agganci la nave alla Silver Albedo. Gli Avgi in grado di muoversi si stringono al petto bracciate di registrazioni e diari mentre salgono a bordo. Dopo che tutti sono stati trasferiti al sicuro sulla <ship>, ti sganci dalla nave in rovina.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|You receive a warm welcome back on Peripheria Station, as the former crew of the Silver Albedo disembarks. Some of the more badly injured crew members are carried out on hammock-like stretchers, but most are able to walk or fly out of the <ship> on their own power.|769|0
units.english: You receive a warm welcome back on Peripheria Station, as the former crew of the Silver Albedo disembarks. Some of the more badly injured crew members are carried out on hammock-like stretchers, but most are able to walk or fly out of the <ship> on their own power.
units.italian: Ricevi un'accoglienza calorosa sulla stazione Peripheria mentre l'ex equipaggio della Silver Albedo sbarca. Alcuni dei feriti più gravi vengono portati fuori su barelle simili ad amache, ma i più riescono a uscire dalla <ship> camminando o volando con le proprie forze.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	After a short celebration and many expressions of deep gratitude toward you, you find Darius and Sora waiting by the <ship> to speak with you.|770|0
units.english: After a short celebration and many expressions of deep gratitude toward you, you find Darius and Sora waiting by the <ship> to speak with you.
units.italian: Dopo un breve festeggiamento e molte espressioni di profonda gratitudine nei tuoi confronti, trovi Darius e Sora che ti aspettano accanto alla <ship> per parlarti.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"<first>, I think we have a golden opportunity," Darius says. "I was just talking to an Assemblyman, Hriso, who's worried about the political situation in the eastern branch of the Tangled Shroud."|771|0
units.english: "<first>, I think we have a golden opportunity," Darius says. "I was just talking to an Assemblyman, Hriso, who's worried about the political situation in the eastern branch of the Tangled Shroud."
units.italian: "<first>, credo che abbiamo un'occasione d'oro", dice Darius. "Stavo parlando con un membro dell'Assemblea, Hriso, preoccupato per la situazione politica nel ramo orientale del Tangled Shroud."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"A bunch of selfish cowards, they are," says Sora disdainfully.|772|0
units.english: "A bunch of selfish cowards, they are," says Sora disdainfully.
units.italian: "Un branco di codardi egoisti", dice Sora con disprezzo.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|	"Something about the miners grumbling about price controls on nickel-iron," Darius says after a moment, "but he wants to know if you could use your jump drive to take him there for some outreach to the miners without needing to spend weeks wandering through the mess of twisted hyperlanes. It's the perfect chance to meet my friend and ask him some questions. Meet me in the spaceport in an hour and we'll get this trip sorted out."|773|0
units.english: "Something about the miners grumbling about price controls on nickel-iron," Darius says after a moment, "but he wants to know if you could use your jump drive to take him there for some outreach to the miners without needing to spend weeks wandering through the mess of twisted hyperlanes. It's the perfect chance to meet my friend and ask him some questions. Meet me in the spaceport in an hour and we'll get this trip sorted out."
units.italian: "Qualcosa sui minatori che brontolano per i controlli sui prezzi del nichel-ferro", dice Darius dopo un momento, "ma vuole sapere se potresti usare il tuo motore di salto per portarlo là a fare opera di convincimento tra i minatori senza dover passare settimane a vagare nel groviglio di ipervie contorte. È l'occasione perfetta per incontrare il mio amico e fargli qualche domanda. Incontrami allo spazioporto tra un'ora e sistemiamo questo viaggio."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Scout Rescue|dialog|775|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the rescued crew hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la scorta con l'equipaggio salvato non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Frontline Combat|name|779|0
units.english: Hunt the Aberrant
units.italian: Caccia agli Aberranti

units.id: mission:Avgi: Frontline Combat|description|780|0
units.english: Help the Avgi clear the systems north of Quintessence of Aberrant to free up defensive resources, then return to the <destination>.
units.italian: Aiuta gli Avgi a ripulire dagli Aberranti i sistemi a nord di Quintessence per liberare risorse difensive, poi torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Frontline Combat|You follow Kokkino's instructions to a prefab building in the spaceport, which looks to be some kind of command center. Kokkino is waiting for you by a table in the middle, which lights up, displaying a map of Avgi space with some colored markings you can't read.|793|0
units.english: You follow Kokkino's instructions to a prefab building in the spaceport, which looks to be some kind of command center. Kokkino is waiting for you by a table in the middle, which lights up, displaying a map of Avgi space with some colored markings you can't read.
units.italian: Segui le indicazioni di Kokkino fino a un edificio prefabbricato nello spazioporto, che sembra una specie di centro di comando. Kokkino ti aspetta accanto a un tavolo al centro, che si illumina mostrando una mappa dello spazio Avgi con segni colorati che non sai leggere.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Frontline Combat|	"Explanation. The Aberrant are relentless, but as a rule push only lightly into the Tangled Shroud. The recent incursion excepted, of course. But Arche holds the first lines of defense, with the Feo Platform and its cannons." He points to a trinary system just outside the Shroud.|794|0
units.english: "Explanation. The Aberrant are relentless, but as a rule push only lightly into the Tangled Shroud. The recent incursion excepted, of course. But Arche holds the first lines of defense, with the Feo Platform and its cannons." He points to a trinary system just outside the Shroud.
units.italian: "Spiegazione. Gli Aberranti sono implacabili, ma di regola si spingono solo marginalmente nel Tangled Shroud. Fatta eccezione per l'incursione recente, naturalmente. Ma Arche tiene le prime linee di difesa, con la Piattaforma Feo e i suoi cannoni." Indica un sistema triplo appena fuori dallo Shroud.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Frontline Combat|	"But, if we are to reclaim our homes, we cannot merely fight on the defensive. Thus, the front lines of this war are as of late drawn in the Quintessence system, and the triangle of systems to its north, which we are still in the process of clearing."|795|0
units.english: "But, if we are to reclaim our homes, we cannot merely fight on the defensive. Thus, the front lines of this war are as of late drawn in the Quintessence system, and the triangle of systems to its north, which we are still in the process of clearing."
units.italian: "Ma se vogliamo riprenderci le nostre case, non possiamo limitarci a combattere in difesa. Perciò di recente il fronte di questa guerra si è spostato nel sistema Quintessence e nel triangolo di sistemi a nord, che stiamo ancora ripulendo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Frontline Combat|	"Where do I come in?"|797|0
units.english: "Where do I come in?"
units.italian: "E io che c'entro?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Frontline Combat|	"What do you want me to do?"|798|0
units.english: "What do you want me to do?"
units.italian: "Cosa volete che faccia?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Frontline Combat|	"Consideration. Your ship is far beyond anything we can produce indigenously, at least for the moment. While you are certainly skilled in fleet combat, I am of the opinion that you would be best put to use launching independent strikes, those that a single one of our vessels could not manage on their own."|799|0
units.english: "Consideration. Your ship is far beyond anything we can produce indigenously, at least for the moment. While you are certainly skilled in fleet combat, I am of the opinion that you would be best put to use launching independent strikes, those that a single one of our vessels could not manage on their own."
units.italian: "Considerazione. La tua nave è molto oltre qualsiasi cosa possiamo produrre in casa, almeno per ora. Sei senz'altro abile nel combattimento di flotta, ma ritengo che il tuo miglior impiego siano gli attacchi indipendenti, quelli che una sola delle nostre navi non potrebbe sostenere da sola."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Frontline Combat|	He looks down at a device similar to a tablet. "With the attack on Ensemble, we were forced to pull back our main fleetgroups from the front lines in Quintessence in an attempt to contain them. While we have since reclaimed many of our initial positions, during all the maneuvering a large number of Aberrant were able to slip past us, not into the Shroud, but rather north, towards the Empyrean system. With the current situation, I do not want to divert an entire strike force from the defenses to hunt them down. Report back to the Feo Platform when the Aberrant are eliminated."|800|0
units.english: He looks down at a device similar to a tablet. "With the attack on Ensemble, we were forced to pull back our main fleetgroups from the front lines in Quintessence in an attempt to contain them. While we have since reclaimed many of our initial positions, during all the maneuvering a large number of Aberrant were able to slip past us, not into the Shroud, but rather north, towards the Empyrean system. With the current situation, I do not want to divert an entire strike force from the defenses to hunt them down. Report back to the Feo Platform when the Aberrant are eliminated."
units.italian: Abbassa lo sguardo su un dispositivo simile a un tablet. "Con l'attacco a Ensemble siamo stati costretti a ritirare i nostri principali gruppi di flotta dal fronte di Quintessence per tentare di contenerli. Da allora abbiamo recuperato molte delle posizioni iniziali, ma durante tutte le manovre un gran numero di Aberranti è riuscito a sgusciarci accanto, non dentro lo Shroud, bensì a nord, verso il sistema Empyrean. Con la situazione attuale non voglio distogliere un'intera forza d'attacco dalle difese per dargli la caccia. Fai rapporto alla Piattaforma Feo quando gli Aberranti saranno eliminati."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Frontline Combat|log|803|0
units.english: Agreed to help Kokkino by clearing out Aberrant stragglers infesting a cluster of systems behind the front lines.
units.italian: Ho accettato di aiutare Kokkino ripulendo i sistemi dietro la prima linea dai gruppi di Aberranti che li infestano.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Frontline Combat|dialog|805|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Aberrant left in the systems to the north. Return once you've killed them all.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora Aberranti nei sistemi a nord. Torna quando li avrai uccisi tutti.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach 0.5|name|850|0
units.english: Return to Peripheria
units.italian: Ritorno a Peripheria

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach 0.5|description|851|0
units.english: Return to <destination> to collect Hriso, a Consonance Assemblyman.
units.italian: Torna su <destination> per prelevare Hriso, un membro dell'Assemblea della Consonanza.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach 0.5|blocked|855|0
units.english: You'll need two free bunks on the <ship> for Darius and Sora.
units.italian: Ti servono due cuccette libere sulla <ship> per Darius e Sora.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach 0.5|You receive a hero's welcome back on the Feo Platform from the Twilight Guards stationed there. After a short celebration and many expressions of praise toward you, an alien stranger, you find Darius and Sora waiting by the <ship> to speak with you.|860|0
units.english: You receive a hero's welcome back on the Feo Platform from the Twilight Guards stationed there. After a short celebration and many expressions of praise toward you, an alien stranger, you find Darius and Sora waiting by the <ship> to speak with you.
units.italian: Sulla Piattaforma Feo ricevi l'accoglienza riservata a un eroe dai membri della Twilight Guard di stanza. Dopo un breve festeggiamento e molte espressioni di elogio nei tuoi confronti, tu che sei un alieno straniero, trovi Darius e Sora che ti aspettano accanto alla <ship> per parlarti.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach 0.5|	"<first>, I think we have a golden opportunity," Darius says. "I was just talking to an Assemblyman, Hriso, who's worried about the political situation in the eastern branch of the Tangled Shroud."|861|0
units.english: "<first>, I think we have a golden opportunity," Darius says. "I was just talking to an Assemblyman, Hriso, who's worried about the political situation in the eastern branch of the Tangled Shroud."
units.italian: "<first>, credo che abbiamo un'occasione d'oro", dice Darius. "Stavo parlando con un membro dell'Assemblea, Hriso, preoccupato per la situazione politica nel ramo orientale del Tangled Shroud."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Dissonance Outreach 0.5|	"A bunch of selfish cowards, they are," says Sora disdainfully.|862|0
units.english: "A bunch of selfish cowards, they are," says Sora disdainfully.
units.italian: "Un branco di codardi egoisti", dice Sora con disprezzo.

units.english: "Something about the miners grumbling about price controls on nickel-iron," Darius says after a moment, "but he wants to know if you could use your jump drive to take him there for some outreach to the miners without needing to spend weeks wandering through the mess of twisted hyperlanes. It's the perfect chance to meet my friend and ask him some questions. We'll need to head to Peripheria to pick up Hriso and get this trip sorted out."
units.italian: "Qualcosa sui minatori che brontolano per i controlli sui prezzi del nichel-ferro", dice Darius dopo un momento, "ma vuole sapere se potresti usare il tuo motore di salto per portarlo là a fare opera di convincimento tra i minatori senza dover passare settimane a vagare nel groviglio di ipervie contorte. È l'occasione perfetta per incontrare il mio amico e fargli qualche domanda. Dovremo andare a Peripheria a prendere Hriso e sistemare questo viaggio."
